prompts.text: Name a domesticated animal (kinds of animal, not breeds)

items.quip: Farmed on prickly pear cactus for carmine red dye.
items.title: Cochineal
items.description: Species of insect producing the crimson dye carmine
items.extract: The cochineal is a scale insect in the suborder Sternorrhyncha, from which the natural dye carmine is derived. A primarily sessile parasite native to tropical and subtropical South America through North America, this insect lives on cacti in the genus Opuntia, feeding on plant moisture and nutrients. The insects are found on the pads of prickly pear cacti, collected by brushing them off the plants, and dried.

items.quip: Domesticated from the wild gaur in northeast India.
items.title: Gayal
items.extract: The gayal, also known as mithun or Drung ox, is a large semi-domesticated cattle in the Himalayan foothills of Indian Subcontinent and primarily in Northeast India.

prompts.text: Name a cat breed (coat patterns don't count)

items.quip: Pom-pom tail from the Kuril Islands between Russia and Japan.
items.title: Kurilian Bobtail
items.extract: The Kurilian Bobtail is a cat breed originating from the Kuril Islands, as well as Sakhalin Island and the Kamchatka peninsula of Russia. Short- or long-haired, it has a semi-cobby body type and a distinct short, fluffy tail. The back is slightly arched with hind legs longer than the front, similar to those of the Manx. The breed is also called the Kuril Islands Bobtail, Kuril Bobtail and Curilsk Bobtail, and may be referred to without "Bobtail". It is sometimes also spelt Kurilean.

items.quip: Sea cucumber that punches with its own innards.
items.title: List of generation VII Pokémon
items.extract: The seventh generation of the Pokémon franchise features 86 fictional species of collectible creatures called "Pokémon" introduced to the core video game series in the 2016 Nintendo 3DS games Pokémon Sun and Moon and the 2017 3DS games Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon. Two further species were introduced in a 2018 update to the spin-off mobile game Pokémon Go, as well as the 2018 core series Nintendo Switch games Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, culminating in a total of 88 different species. Some Pokémon species in this generation were introduced in animated adaptations of the franchise before Sun and Moon.

items.quip: Sushi-shaped mimic that hides inside Dondozo's mouth.
items.title: List of generation IX Pokémon
items.extract: The ninth generation of the Pokémon franchise features 120 titular species of creatures introduced to the core video game series in the Nintendo Switch games Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. The first Pokémon of the generation were revealed on 27 February 2022 in a Pokémon Presents livestream presentation. Scarlet and Violet were released on 18 November 2022.

prompts.text: Name a movie starring Will Smith

items.quip: His 1992 film debut, among homeless youths in Los Angeles.
items.title: Where the Day Takes You
items.extract: Where the Day Takes You is a 1992 American drama film directed by Marc Rocco. The film stars Sean Astin, Lara Flynn Boyle, Peter Dobson, Balthazar Getty, Ricki Lake, James LeGros, Dermot Mulroney, and Will Smith in his film debut. Its plot follows a group of teenage runaways trying to survive on the streets of Los Angeles. The film was released on September 11, 1992.

prompts.text: Name a country with two syllables (English pronunciation; constituent countries don't count)

items.quip: Two syllables, roughly 340 islands, and one of the smallest UN members.
items.title: Palau
items.extract: Palau, officially the Republic of Palau, is an island country located in the Micronesia subregion of Oceania in the western Pacific Ocean. The Republic of Palau consists of approximately 340 islands and is the western part of the Caroline Islands, while the eastern and central parts make up the Federated States of Micronesia.

prompts.text: Name a modern country that was partly ruled by the Roman Empire (constituent countries don't count)

items.quip: Rome's Arabia Petraea reached Hegra in today's Hejaz.
items.title: Saudi Arabia
items.extract: Saudi Arabia, officially the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), is a country in West Asia that occupies the bulk of the Arabian Peninsula. Covering a land area of approximately 2,149,690 km2 (830,000 sq mi), it is the fifth-largest country in Asia and the twelfth-largest in the world. It is bordered by the Red Sea to the west, Jordan, Iraq, and Kuwait to the north, the Arabian Gulf, Bahrain, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates to the east, Oman to the southeast, and Yemen to the south. The Gulf of Aqaba in the northwest separates it from Egypt and Israel. Riyadh is the capital and largest city, while other major centers include Jeddah and the two holiest cities in Islam, Mecca and Medina.

items.quip: Gerulata, a Roman fort, sits inside modern Bratislava.
items.title: Slovakia
items.extract: Slovakia, officially the Slovak Republic, is a landlocked country in Central Europe. It is bordered by Poland to the north, Ukraine to the east, Hungary to the south, Austria to the west, and the Czech Republic to the northwest. Slovakia's mostly mountainous territory spans about 49,000 km2 (19,000 sq mi), hosting a population exceeding 5.4 million. The capital and largest city is Bratislava, while the second largest city is Košice.
